description: Slice #3 flat-pattern golden for an AUTHORED L-bracket (base flange + ONE edge flange) unfolded by PROVENANCE (docs/design/sheet-metal.md §4.2/§5/§6, §9 goldens #1/#2/#4). Where Spike 0 unfolded a test-built body, this rebuilds the SAME analytic L-bracket from a real feature tree (sketch -> sheet_metal_base_flange -> sheet_metal_edge_flange), tags the bend with a CylindricalFaceSignature at construction, and finds it back by that signature (never blind detection). Proves the proven unfold math unfolds something a user actually modelled.
tangent_line_convention: Flat length is measured to the bend TANGENT LINES (§9 #1). The base flange's developed leg is the full length of its flat top face (50 mm, from the far edge to the bend tangent line at the folded edge); the edge flange's developed leg is its own flat face length (30 mm). The bend allowance BA REPLACES the two setback segments a sharp-corner unfold would use.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, not recorded harness output (geometry-gates skill). Dims: base flange 50 x 20 mm (developed leg 50, width 20), edge flange developed leg 30 mm, gauge t = 2 mm, inner bend radius r = 3 mm, bend angle 90 deg = pi/2, K = 0.44 (v1 default).

Flat length (§9 #1): flat_length = base_leg + BA + flange_leg = 50 + 6.094689747964199 + 30 = 86.0946897479642 mm. Measured kernel-side deviation vs analytic: ~1e-13 (the arc-fit inner radius carries FP noise: BRepAdaptor reports 2.9999999999999933 for the nominal-3 mm bend, propagating ~1.2e-13 into BA).

Developed area (§9 #2, neutral-surface conservation): flat_area = base_area + flange_area + BA*width = (50*20) + (30*20) + (6.094689747964199*20) = 1000 + 600 + 121.89379... = 1721.893794959284 mm^2. Equivalently flat_length * width = 86.0946897479642 * 20 (the blank is a rectangle).

Fold direction is inferred from the geometry (§5): the edge flange folds to the +normal side of the base flange, so direction = 'up' (clearing Spike 0's deferred up/down inference risk). Fold angle = 90 deg exactly (axis-aligned flange normals, dot 0.0).
Fused body volume = base plate (50*20*2 = 2000) + flange (cross-section 30*2 + quarter annulus (pi/4)(5^2-3^2) = 60 + 4*pi = 72.5663706, * 20 width = 1451.3274123) = 3451.3274123 mm^3 (analytic).

content_hash is the sha256 of the provenance-driven FlatPattern.to_json_bytes(). It is a DETERMINISM PIN (byte-identity), not analytic -- reproducible in-process AND across a fresh interpreter restart (§9 #4). Version-pinned like the STEP/PDF export goldens: the arc-fit inner radius is OCCT/build123d-version-specific FP, so an OCCT/build123d bump regenerates this hash. A change WITHOUT a kernel-version bump is a determinism regression (P0), never a retry.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill). The bend allowance is a four-term closed form and the developed legs are exact OCCT face extents. Measured deviations vs the hand-derived values (2026-07-19, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): flat_length residual ~1.2e-13, flat_area residual ~2.4e-12, BA residual ~1.2e-13 (arc-fit inner radius 2.9999999999999933). Documented ceiling 1e-9 gives ~4 orders of headroom over the observed worst case for platform FP variation, while staying tighter than the standing kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m). The volume tolerance (1e-6) absorbs the same arc-fit noise scaled by the 20 mm width.
